Our #1 overall pick for SEA buyers who want a fully transparent, caffeine-free daily cognitive stack.
whatItIs: Mind Lab Pro is an 11-ingredient pre-formulated nootropic stack sold by Performance Lab Group Ltd (Royal Leamington Spa, UK) per mindlabpro.com's terms; the brand's own posts say it was formulated by Opti-Nutra in the UK (checked 2026-10-08). It is designed as a complete daily cognitive supplement covering memory, focus, mental energy, mood, and long-term brain health without caffeine or proprietary blends. For SEA buyers it is a premium import: the brand's FAQ names Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia and Vietnam among the territories it ships to (checked 2026-09-29); Malaysia is not named on that partial list, so confirm delivery to your country and any duties at checkout before ordering. It is brought in as a personal-use supplement; we have not verified a local product registration with the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency (NPRA) in Malaysia, the Thai FDA, FDA Philippines, the Badan Pengawas Obat dan Makanan (BPOM) in Indonesia or the Vietnam Food Administration (VFA). Personal-import quantity rules were not confirmed from an official page in our 2026-10-05 check, so confirm them with your national customs authority before ordering; import duties and customs clearance are the buyer's responsibility.
howItWorks: Mind Lab Pro works across six bio-pathways simultaneously. Citicoline and Phosphatidylserine support the cholinergic system and neuronal membrane integrity. Lion's Mane stimulates Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) for neuroplasticity. Bacopa Monnieri enhances synaptic communication for memory. Rhodiola Rosea and L-Tyrosine support dopamine/norepinephrine balance under stress. L-Theanine promotes alpha brain wave activity for calm focus. B-vitamins (B6, B9, B12) support homocysteine regulation and neurotransmitter synthesis.
whatToExpect: Within 30-60 minutes: mild calm focus from L-Theanine. Within 2-4 weeks: improved mental energy and reduced cognitive fatigue (Citicoline, Tyrosine). At 8-12 weeks: measurable improvements in memory recall and learning speed (Bacopa, Lion's Mane). Mind Lab Pro is a long-game supplement -- most users report subtle but sustained improvement rather than dramatic day-one effects. Best results require 3+ months of consistent daily use.

whatItIs: Alpha Brain is Onnit's flagship nootropic product, first released in 2011 and popularised through Joe Rogan's podcast endorsements. It is the best-recognised nootropic brand in the mainstream US market and one of only two nootropic supplements with published clinical trial data on its specific formula. It is National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Certified for Sport, making it suitable for drug-tested athletes. For SEA buyers, Alpha Brain's mainstream name recognition means it is easier to research and find community reviews in local languages -- a meaningful advantage over niche brands. It ships from Onnit's US warehouse and enters the region as a personal-use supplement; we have not verified a local product registration with the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency (NPRA) in Malaysia, the Thai FDA, FDA Philippines, the Badan Pengawas Obat dan Makanan (BPOM) in Indonesia or the Vietnam Food Administration (VFA). howItWorks: Alpha Brain uses three proprietary blends -- Onnit Flow Blend, Focus Blend, and Fuel Blend -- containing cholinergics (Alpha-GPC), adaptogens (Bacopa), and amino acids (Tyrosine, Theanine). The label states each blend's total and two individual amounts (Bacopa 100mg, Huperzine A 400mcg): Bacopa, Alpha-GPC (at most 140mg) and L-Tyrosine (at most 650mg) fall short of their clinical doses, and the other blend members cannot be checked individually. Low price and small package size minimise customs exposure across all SEA markets.
whatItIs: Nootropics Depot Lion's Mane Extract is a single-ingredient supplement providing standardised Hericium erinaceus fruiting body extract at 500mg per capsule. Nootropics Depot is widely regarded as the most rigorous ingredient-quality focused retailer in the US nootropics market, operating an ISO-certified in-house testing laboratory and publishing a Certificate of Analysis (CoA) for each batch. For SEA buyers, this product represents one of the lowest-risk imports in the category: the low price (USD $25/month), small package size, and single-ingredient simplicity mean it is unlikely to attract customs attention in any SEA market. It enters the region as a personal-use supplement -- the same import pathway as the other imported products in this review -- and we have not verified a local product registration with the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency (NPRA) in Malaysia, the Thai FDA, FDA Philippines, the Badan Pengawas Obat dan Makanan (BPOM) in Indonesia or the Vietnam Food Administration (VFA). Lion's Mane is a well-known functional mushroom in Southeast Asian traditional food culture, which may ease any regulatory ambiguity for buyers in markets with stricter supplement import enforcement.
howItWorks: Lion's Mane fruiting body contains hericenones, compounds that cross the blood-brain barrier and stimulate Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) synthesis. NGF promotes neuronal survival, axon growth, and maintenance of neurons in the hippocampus and cortex -- the regions responsible for learning and memory. Nootropics Depot uses a standardised fruiting body extract rather than mycelium (which has a lower hericenone content). The result is a more potent and consistent NGF stimulus per capsule.
whatToExpect: Lion's Mane is a long-game supplement. Expect no acute effects on day one. At 4 weeks: some users report slightly clearer thinking and improved mental endurance. At 8-12 weeks: measurable improvements in memory and neuroprotective markers in studies. For best results, take consistently every day with a fat-containing meal (hericenones are fat-soluble). This product is best combined with a multi-ingredient stack (e.g. Mind Lab Pro already contains Lion's Mane) rather than used as a standalone primary supplement.

name: Eu Yan Sang BrainMAX+
seoTitle: Eu Yan Sang BrainMAX+ Review: Cera-Q Evidence & Price
seoDescription: BrainMAX+ uses 600mg Cera-Q silk protein, backed by one 3-week maker-affiliated trial; Korea's MFDS revoked its recognition in 2017. S$69.90/30 sachets.
summary: Eu Yan Sang BrainMAX+ is a premium brain health supplement from Southeast Asia's most trusted Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) brand, with 200+ retail stores across Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and Australia. Uses Cera-Q, a silk fibroin protein with one citable 3-week memory trial by maker-affiliated authors, combined with Goji Berry and Chinese Wild Ginseng. Priced at S$69.90 for a 30-sachet box (reduced from the S$89.90 RSP; about US$54.71) on euyansang.com.sg, checked 2026-09-29. Available in-store and online, with same-day courier delivery to Singapore addresses for orders placed before the cut-off (euyansang.com.sg delivery FAQ, checked 2026-09-29). Delivery outside Singapore was not confirmed in that check -- confirm at checkout.
whatItIs: Eu Yan Sang is a 145-year-old Traditional Chinese Medicine company founded in 1879, with over 200 retail locations across Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Macau, and Australia. BrainMAX+ is their modern cognitive health line, featuring Cera-Q — a silk fibroin protein extract with one citable 3-week trial in healthy adults averaging about 55 (Kang 2018, maker-affiliated authors) showing higher memory-test scores at 400–600mg/day (the trial tested 280–600mg). The formula bridges TCM tradition (Goji Berry, Chinese Wild Ginseng) with modern clinical ingredients. For SEA buyers, Eu Yan Sang offers unmatched trust and accessibility: walk into any Eu Yan Sang store in Singapore or Malaysia, or order online for same-day delivery within Singapore (orders before the cut-off). We could not confirm delivery terms outside Singapore in our 2026-09-29 check of the storefront's delivery FAQ -- confirm at checkout.
howItWorks: Cera-Q (silk fibroin protein hydrolysate) has no established mechanism in human studies; the one 3-week trial we could cite reported dose-dependent gains on a memory quotient, learning gradient and recall measures at 400–600mg/day (the trial tested 280–600mg). Goji Berry extract provides antioxidant neuroprotection via zeaxanthin and betaine compounds. Chinese Wild Ginseng extract contains ginsenosides that modulate NMDA receptor activity and support cerebral blood flow. The formula combines modern peptide science with TCM botanical tradition.
whatToExpect: BrainMAX+ comes as powder sachets dissolved in water — a familiar format in Asian health culture. The one Cera-Q trial we could cite measured memory after 3 weeks; it did not measure mental clarity or onset. Weeks 4-8: cumulative memory and concentration benefits from the ginseng and goji combination. At S$69.90 per 30-sachet box (S$89.90 RSP) it is priced as a premium product, but the Eu Yan Sang brand carries deep trust across Chinese-heritage communities in Southeast Asia.
pros: Cera-Q has a placebo-controlled memory trial (3 weeks, maker-affiliated)
Same-day courier delivery in Singapore (orders before the cut-off)
cons: Korea's food regulator (MFDS) revoked Cera-Q's functional-ingredient recognition in November 2017 after its supporting mouse study was retracted for data fabrication (retraction notice: J Microbiol Biotechnol, Dec 2016); in Korea it is sold as a general food (per Yang & Chung 2026, Food Supplements and Biomaterials for Health, and Sisa Journal, Feb 2020). This does not affect its legal status in Singapore or the other Southeast Asian markets where BrainMAX+ is sold as a supplement.
Cera-Q's evidence is one citable 3-week trial with maker-affiliated authors; an earlier supporting paper was retracted

whatItIs: Memo Plus Gold is a Philippine food supplement containing a single active ingredient: 125mg of Bacopa Monnieri extract per capsule. It is one of the most widely recognised memory supplements in the Philippines, stocked by major pharmacy chains (Mercury Drug, Watsons, Southstar) and online marketplaces, and is registered with the Philippine Food and Drug Administration (FDA Philippines). Unlike the multi-ingredient imported stacks elsewhere in this review, it is a focused, traditional single-herb product. howItWorks: Bacopa Monnieri is the most extensively studied botanical for memory. Its active bacosides enhance synaptic communication by promoting dendritic branching and synaptic density, support repair of damaged neurons, and modulate the acetylcholine and serotonin systems involved in learning and recall. The label dose of two 125mg capsules daily (250mg/day) sits just below the 300mg/day used in most clinical trials. Because bacosides are fat-soluble, absorption improves significantly when the capsules are taken with a meal containing some fat.
whatToExpect: Bacopa is a slow-build, cumulative supplement — not an acute focus pill. Most of its measured benefits to memory and recall appear after 8-12 weeks of consistent daily use, so regularity matters far more than any single dose. A minority of users notice mild digestive upset or a brief 'Bacopa fog' in the first few weeks as the serotonin system adjusts; this typically resolves. A 30-capsule bottle lasts about 15 days at the label dose, so plan on roughly two bottles per month. Take with food for best absorption.
